title: Android SDK variables
description: Configuration variables for the Android SDK command-line tools recipe

ANDROID_SDK_VERSION.description: Revision number of Google Android commandlinetools to install (or 'latest').

ANDROID_PLATFORM.description: Android SDK platform package identifier to install via sdkmanager.

ANDROID_BUILD_TOOLS.description: Android SDK build-tools package identifier to install via sdkmanager.

ANDROID_SDK_DOWNLOAD_URL.description: Optional explicit download URL override for the commandlinetools archive.
